summary.en: Starts the car from a set height on a slope.
summary.zh: 让小车从斜坡上同一高度出发。

detail.en:
A wooden board 42 cm long, propped up at 14 degrees in this design [S1]. The car is let go from 3, 6 or 9 cm above the runway. Starting from the same height every time is one of the things a fair test keeps the same [S2].

The higher the start, the faster the car reaches the runway. In this model doubling the height doubles how far it rolls [S1].
detail.zh:
一块长 42 cm 的木板，本设计把它垫成 14° 的斜坡 [S1]。小车从比跑道高 3、6 或 9 cm 的地方放手。每次都从同一高度出发，是公平测试里保持不变的量之一 [S2]。

出发点越高，小车到达跑道时就越快。在这个模型里，高度加倍，滚出的距离也加倍 [S1]。

summary.en: Props up the top end of the ramp.
summary.zh: 垫高斜面的上端。

detail.en: A wooden block about 10 cm tall under the top of the ramp [S1]. A taller block would make the slope steeper. In this topic the slope never changes; only the release height does.
detail.zh: 斜面上端下面的一块木块，高约 10 cm [S1]。垫块越高，坡就越陡。这一课里坡度始终不变，只改变放手的高度。

summary.en: Marks where the car is let go, with no push.
summary.zh: 标出小车放手的位置，不推。

detail.en: A small gate across the ramp at the release height: 3, 6 or 9 cm above the runway in this design [S1]. The car waits behind it; when the gate is lifted, the car starts by itself. Nobody pushes it, so every run starts the same way.
detail.zh: 横在斜面上的一道小挡板，位置就是释放高度：本设计为比跑道高 3、6 或 9 cm [S1]。小车停在挡板后面；挡板一抬起，小车就自己出发。没有人推它，所以每一次都以同样的方式出发。

summary.en: A level wooden board where the car rolls to a stop.
summary.zh: 一块水平的木板，小车在上面滚到停下。

detail.en:
A board 1.30 m long and 28 cm wide with low side rails and a stop at the far end [S1]. Bare, it is the wooden surface; a glass sheet or a strip of carpet can be laid on it.

From the three release heights the car always stops before the end stop in this model [S1].
detail.zh:
一块长 1.30 m、宽 28 cm 的木板，两侧有矮护边，远端有挡板 [S1]。什么都不铺时就是木表面；也可以在上面铺一块玻璃板或一条地毯。

在这个模型里，从三种释放高度出发，小车都会在挡板前停下 [S1]。

summary.en: A smooth surface laid on the runway.
summary.zh: 铺在跑道上的光滑表面。

detail.en:
A sheet of glass 1.24 m long laid on the runway [S1]. On glass the car rolls furthest: about 80 cm from a 6 cm start in this model [S1].

The model's numbers are chosen so that every run fits on the bench; a real toy car rolls much further on glass. What the model gets right is the order of the surfaces [S1, S12].
detail.zh:
铺在跑道上的一块玻璃，长 1.24 m [S1]。小车在玻璃上滚得最远：在这个模型里，从 6 cm 高处出发约滚 80 cm [S1]。

模型的数字是为了让每一次都能在实验台上跑完而取的；真实的玩具车在玻璃上会滚得远得多。模型说对的是几种表面的先后顺序 [S1, S12]。

summary.en: A soft, furry surface that slows the car quickly.
summary.zh: 柔软起绒的表面，让小车很快慢下来。

detail.en:
A strip of short-pile carpet laid on the runway [S1]. From a 6 cm start the car stops after about 19 cm in this model [S1].

As the wheels roll, they press the fibres down and the fibres spring back. That takes effort, so carpet slows the car more than its look alone suggests [S12, S17].
detail.zh:
铺在跑道上的一条短绒地毯 [S1]。在这个模型里，从 6 cm 高处出发，小车约 19 cm 就停了 [S1]。

车轮滚过时把绒毛压下去，绒毛又弹起来。这很费劲，所以地毯让小车慢下来的本事比看上去大 [S12, S17]。

summary.en: Measures how far the car rolls.
summary.zh: 量小车滚了多远。

detail.en: A 1.2 m rule with a mark every centimetre and a longer mark every 10 cm, laid along the runway [S1]. The distance is measured from the foot of the ramp to where the car stops.
detail.zh: 沿跑道放的一把 1.2 m 长的尺，每厘米一条刻线，每 10 cm 一条长刻线 [S1]。距离从斜面底端量到小车停下的地方。

summary.en: Rolls down the ramp and along the runway.
summary.zh: 沿斜面滚下，再沿跑道滚动。

detail.en:
A small plastic car 9 cm long on four wheels [S1]. In chapter 1 it is pushed; in chapter 4 it is let go on the ramp.

Once it leaves the ramp, nothing pushes it. It keeps moving by itself until friction brings it to a stop [S3]. Many learners expect a moving thing to need a push to keep going; it does not [S13, S14]. In this model the car's mass does not change how far it rolls [S1].
detail.zh:
一辆 9 cm 长的四轮塑料小车 [S1]。第 1 章里推它；第 4 章里让它从斜面上自己滚下来。

离开斜面以后，没有东西推它。它自己一直往前走，直到摩擦力让它停下 [S3]。很多人以为运动的东西要一直有力推着才能继续走，其实不需要 [S13, S14]。在这个模型里，小车的质量不影响它滚多远 [S1]。

summary.en: Let the car roll instead of slide.
summary.zh: 让小车滚动，而不是滑动。

detail.en:
Four rubber wheels 22 mm across [S1]. A car on wheels rolls much further than a block sliding on the same surface.

No friction arrow is drawn on the wheels: which way friction acts on rolling things is not part of the primary syllabus [S2].
detail.zh:
四只直径 22 mm 的橡胶轮 [S1]。装在轮子上的小车，比在同一表面上滑动的木块走得远得多。

车轮上不画摩擦力箭头：滚动的物体受到的摩擦力朝哪个方向，不在小学课纲之内 [S2]。

summary.en: Three lanes side by side: glass, wood and sandpaper.
summary.zh: 三条并排的道：玻璃、木和砂纸。

detail.en: A wooden board 60 × 24 cm with three lanes: a strip of glass at the back, bare wood in the middle and sandpaper at the front [S1]. The block is pulled along one lane at a time.
detail.zh: 一块 60 × 24 cm 的木板，分三条道：后面是一条玻璃，中间是木面，前面是砂纸 [S1]。每次只在一条道上拉木块。

summary.en: The smoothest lane on the board.
summary.zh: 板上最光滑的一条道。

detail.en:
In this model the block needs about 0.5 N to start sliding on glass and about 0.4 N to keep it sliding [S1].

These glass values are illustrative. The usual friction tables do not list wood on glass, so the model uses chosen values that put the lanes in a sensible order [S1, S4].
detail.zh:
在这个模型里，木块在玻璃上要约 0.5 N 才开始滑，约 0.4 N 就能保持滑动 [S1]。

玻璃的这两个数是示意值。常见的摩擦数据表里没有木头对玻璃，所以模型取了能让几条道排出合理顺序的值 [S1, S4]。

summary.en: The roughest lane on the board.
summary.zh: 板上最粗糙的一条道。

detail.en:
Sandpaper is covered with hard grains that catch on the wood. In this model the block needs about 1.8 N to start sliding and about 1.4 N to keep it sliding [S1].

Like the glass values, these are illustrative and chosen for their order [S1].
detail.zh:
砂纸表面布满坚硬的颗粒，会卡住木头。在这个模型里，木块要约 1.8 N 才开始滑，约 1.4 N 能保持滑动 [S1]。

和玻璃的数一样，这些也是示意值，取的是它们的先后顺序 [S1]。

summary.en: Pulled across each lane in turn.
summary.zh: 依次在每条道上被拉动。

detail.en:
A wooden block 10 × 6 × 4 cm with a hook at one end, 200 g in this design [S1]. On the wooden lane it needs about 1.0 N to start sliding and about 0.6 N to keep sliding in this model [S1, S4].

Turned onto a smaller face, the same block on the same lane gives about the same readings: friction depends on how hard the surfaces press together, not on how much of them touch [S4].
detail.zh:
一块 10 × 6 × 4 cm 的木块，一端有钩，本设计重 200 g [S1]。在这个模型里，它在木面道上要约 1.0 N 才开始滑，约 0.6 N 能保持滑动 [S1, S4]。

把同一块木块侧过来，用较小的一面放在同一条道上，读数差不多一样：摩擦力取决于两个表面压得有多紧，而不是接触的面积有多大 [S4]。

summary.en: Make the block heavier, so it presses harder.
summary.zh: 让木块更重，压得更紧。

detail.en:
Two brass weights of 200 g each [S1]. With both on the block, 600 g in all, the pull needed to start it on wood rises to about 2.9 N in this model [S1].

A heavier block presses harder on the lane, and friction grows with how hard the surfaces press together [S4].
detail.zh:
两只黄铜砝码，每只 200 g [S1]。两只都放上去，连木块一共 600 g，在这个模型里，在木面道上开始滑动所需的拉力升到约 2.9 N [S1]。

木块越重，压在道上就越紧；两个表面压得越紧，摩擦力越大 [S4]。

summary.en: Measures the pull on the block in newtons.
summary.zh: 以牛顿为单位量木块受到的拉力。

detail.en:
A tube with a spring inside and a scale behind a clear window, reading up to 10 N in this design [S1]. The harder the pull, the more the spring stretches, so the case slides along past the pointer.

School spring balances of this size are marked in steps of 0.1 or 0.2 N [S23, S25].
detail.zh:
一根管子，里面装着弹簧，透明窗后面是刻度，本设计最大读数 10 N [S1]。拉得越用力，弹簧伸得越长，外壳就沿着指针滑过更多刻度。

这种大小的学校弹簧秤，刻度每格 0.1 N 或 0.2 N [S23, S25]。

summary.en: Stretches more the harder the block is pulled.
summary.zh: 拉得越用力，伸得越长。

detail.en: A steel spring fixed at the ring end of the balance [S1]. In this design it stretches 1 cm for every newton of pull: the same idea as the spring in chapter 5 [S1, S7].
detail.zh: 固定在弹簧秤拉环一端的钢弹簧 [S1]。本设计每 1 N 的拉力让它伸长 1 cm：和第 5 章的弹簧是同一个道理 [S1, S7]。

summary.en: Shows the reading against the scale.
summary.zh: 对着刻度显示读数。

detail.en: The hook, its rod and the pointer move together at the spring's free end [S1]. While the block holds still the reading climbs; once the block slides, it drops back to a steady value [S1, S4]. So a still block has forces on it: the pull, and friction just as big [S16].
detail.zh: 挂钩、钩杆和指针连在一起，挂在弹簧的自由端 [S1]。木块还不动时，读数一直往上升；木块一滑动，读数就回落到一个稳定的值 [S1, S4]。可见不动的木块身上也有力：拉力，以及和它一样大的摩擦力 [S16]。

summary.en: Joins the block to the balance, kept level.
summary.zh: 把木块和弹簧秤连起来，保持水平。

detail.en: A short cord from the block's hook to the balance's hook [S1]. Pulling level and steadily is one of the things kept the same in the fair test; pulling upwards would lift the block a little and change the reading.
detail.zh: 从木块的钩连到弹簧秤挂钩的一段短线 [S1]。水平、平稳地拉，是公平测试里保持不变的做法之一；斜着往上拉会把木块稍稍提起，读数就变了。

summary.en: Holds the test spring and the weighing balance.
summary.zh: 挂着弹簧和称重用的弹簧秤。

detail.en: A heavy base, an upright rod 62 cm tall, a clamp and a cross arm [S1]. The arm holds the test spring near one end and a spring balance at the other.
detail.zh: 一个沉重的底座、一根高 62 cm 的立杆、一个夹子和一根横杆 [S1]。横杆一端挂着实验用的弹簧，另一端挂着一只弹簧秤。

summary.en: Stretches further the more weight hangs on it.
summary.zh: 挂得越重，伸得越长。

detail.en:
A steel spring 8.0 cm long with a loop at each end [S1]. In this model each 50 g stretches it by 1.0 cm, up to 300 g [S1, S7]. Stretched, it pulls back up on the hanger: that pull is the elastic spring force.

Past 300 g it stretches faster and stays longer when the load is taken off: 1.2 cm longer after 400 g in this model. These values are illustrative for a school spring [S1, S7].
detail.zh:
一根长 8.0 cm 的钢弹簧，两端各有一个环 [S1]。在这个模型里，300 g 以内每挂 50 g 就伸长 1.0 cm [S1, S7]。被拉长的弹簧把挂钩往上拉，这个拉力就是弹簧的弹力。

超过 300 g，它伸得更快；取下砝码后也回不到原来的长度：在这个模型里，挂过 400 g 后比原来长 1.2 cm。这些数是学校弹簧的示意值 [S1, S7]。

summary.en: A 50 g hanger that the slotted masses sit on.
summary.zh: 50 g 的挂钩，槽码叠放在上面。

detail.en: A brass hanger of 50 g with a base and a rod [S1, S24]. Its pointer reads the stretch on the ruler. The hanger counts in the load: the hanger alone is 50 g, the hanger with two slotted masses is 150 g.
detail.zh: 一个 50 g 的黄铜挂钩，有底盘和一根杆 [S1, S24]。挂钩上的指针在竖尺上读出伸长。挂钩本身也算在载荷里：只挂挂钩是 50 g，挂钩加两片槽码是 150 g。

summary.en: Each slotted mass adds 50 grams.
summary.zh: 每片槽码 50 克。

detail.en: Brass discs of 50 g each with a slot, so they slide onto the hanger's rod from the side [S1, S24]. Up to seven fit on the hanger here: 400 g with the hanger.
detail.zh: 每片 50 g 的黄铜圆片，开有一道槽，可以从侧面套进挂钩的杆 [S1, S24]。这里最多能放七片，连挂钩一共 400 g。

summary.en: Reads how far the spring has stretched.
summary.zh: 读出弹簧伸长了多少。

detail.en: A 30 cm rule marked every centimetre [S1]. The extension is the extra length: read the pointer before and after adding a load, and take one reading from the other.
detail.zh: 一把 30 cm 长的尺，每厘米一条刻线 [S1]。伸长是多出来的那段长度：加砝码前后各读一次指针，两次读数相减。

summary.en: Shows an object's weight in newtons.
summary.zh: 以牛顿为单位称出物体的重量。

detail.en:
The same kind of balance as on the friction board, hung from the stand [S1]. An object on its hook pulls the spring down with its weight, the pull of gravity on it. In this model the 224 g steel ball reads about 2.2 N [S1].

A sheet of paper weighs about 0.05 N, too little for this balance to show: it reads 0.0 N [S1, S23].
detail.zh:
和摩擦板上那只同一类的弹簧秤，挂在铁架台上 [S1]。挂在钩上的物体用它的重量把弹簧往下拉，重量就是重力对它的拉力。在这个模型里，224 g 的钢球读数约 2.2 N [S1]。

一张纸的重量约 0.05 N，太轻了，这只秤读不出来，读数是 0.0 N [S1, S23]。

summary.en: Stretches by the weight of what hangs below.
summary.zh: 被下面所挂物体的重量拉长。

detail.en: Fixed at the top of the balance; 1 cm of stretch for each newton in this design [S1].
detail.zh: 固定在弹簧秤上端；本设计每 1 N 伸长 1 cm [S1]。

summary.en: Moves down the scale as the weight pulls.
summary.zh: 重量往下拉时，沿刻度往下走。

detail.en: Hook, rod and pointer hang from the spring's lower end and move down with it [S1].
detail.zh: 挂钩、钩杆和指针挂在弹簧下端，跟着它一起往下移 [S1]。

summary.en: Holds a ball or the paper on the hook.
summary.zh: 把钢球或纸挂在钩上。

detail.en: Four light cords and a ring that hold what is being weighed [S1]. Its own weight is too small for this balance to show.
detail.zh: 四根细线和一个小环，兜住要称的东西 [S1]。网兜本身太轻，这只秤读不出它的重量。

summary.en: Holds things at a set height above the sand.
summary.zh: 把物体固定在沙面上方一定高度。

detail.en:
An upright rod 1.6 m tall on a heavy base, standing on the floor beside the bench, with marks at 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 m above the sand [S1].

Never drop things from a height where someone could be below [S28].
detail.zh:
一根高 1.6 m 的立杆，装在沉重的底座上，立在实验台旁的地上；立杆上在沙面以上 0.5、1.0、1.5 m 处各有一道标记 [S1]。

不要从高处往下扔东西，下面可能有人 [S28]。

summary.en: Let go of two objects at the same moment.
summary.zh: 让两个物体在同一时刻放开。

detail.en: Two clamps on one arm that open together, so neither object gets a head start [S1]. The arm slides up and down the rod to the chosen height. Letting go together, from the same height, keeps the comparison fair.
detail.zh: 同一根横臂上的两只夹子，一起张开，谁也不会先走一步 [S1]。横臂可以沿立杆上下移到选定的高度。同一高度、同时放手，比较才公平。

summary.en: Catches the falling objects where they land.
summary.zh: 接住落下的物体。

detail.en: A shallow tray of sand on the floor [S1]. Sand stops the balls without a bounce, so it is easy to tell which landed first.
detail.zh: 放在地上的一个浅沙盘 [S1]。沙子接住钢球，不让它弹起来，所以容易看出谁先落地。

summary.en: A 28 g steel ball, 19 mm across.
summary.zh: 一只 28 g、直径 19 mm 的钢球。

detail.en: Steel has about 7.8 grams in every cubic centimetre, so a ball 19 mm across is about 28 g [S26]. In this model it falls 1.0 m in about 0.45 s, the same time as the big ball [S1, S6]. Its weight is about 0.3 N [S1].
detail.zh: 钢每立方厘米约 7.8 克，所以直径 19 mm 的钢球约 28 g [S26]。在这个模型里，它下落 1.0 m 约用 0.45 s，和大钢球一样 [S1, S6]。它的重量约 0.3 N [S1]。

summary.en: Eight times as heavy as the small ball.
summary.zh: 是小钢球的八倍重。

detail.en:
Twice as wide as the small ball, 38 mm, so it holds eight times as much steel: about 224 g [S1, S26]. In this model it falls 1.0 m in about 0.45 s, landing together with the small ball [S1, S6]. Many people expect the heavier ball to land first [S15].

Hung on the weighing balance it reads about 2.2 N: that is its weight [S1].
detail.zh:
直径 38 mm，是小钢球的两倍，所以钢的量是它的八倍：约 224 g [S1, S26]。在这个模型里，它下落 1.0 m 约用 0.45 s，和小钢球同时落地 [S1, S6]。很多人以为重的球会先落地 [S15]。

挂在称重弹簧秤上，读数约 2.2 N，这就是它的重量 [S1]。

summary.en: A sheet of A4 paper, kept flat.
summary.zh: 一张摊平的 A4 纸。

detail.en:
An A4 sheet, 210 × 297 mm, of 80 g/m² paper weighs about 5 g [S27]. Spread flat, it meets a lot of air: in this model it takes about 1.00 s to fall 1.0 m [S1, S6].

Real paper tips, flutters and slides sideways, so its real fall is more irregular than in this model [S1].
detail.zh:
一张 210 × 297 mm 的 A4 纸，用的是 80 g/m² 的纸，约重 5 g [S27]。摊平以后，它碰到很多空气：在这个模型里，下落 1.0 m 约用 1.00 s [S1, S6]。

真的纸会翻转、飘动、往旁边滑，下落比模型里不规则得多 [S1]。

summary.en: A matching sheet, crumpled into a ball.
summary.zh: 一样的一张纸，揉成一团。

detail.en: The same mass, about 5 g, crumpled into a ball about 5 cm across [S1, S27]. Much less air pushes back on it: in this model it falls 1.0 m in about 0.46 s, almost as fast as the steel balls [S1, S6].
detail.zh: 质量一样，约 5 g，揉成直径约 5 cm 的一团 [S1, S27]。空气对它的向上推力小得多：在这个模型里，下落 1.0 m 约用 0.46 s，几乎和钢球一样快 [S1, S6]。

summary.en: Spins on the stand until friction stops it.
summary.zh: 在架子上转，直到摩擦力让它停下。

detail.en:
A 16-inch bicycle wheel, about 40 cm across, set spinning at 2 turns each second [S1]. With the brake off, only a little friction at the hub slows it: in this model it keeps turning for about 80 s [S1, S29].

The wheel's numbers are illustrative, for a wheel on a stand with no rider. They are not stopping times for a bicycle on a road [S1].
detail.zh:
一只 16 英寸的自行车轮，直径约 40 cm，起转时每秒 2 圈 [S1]。不捏刹车，只有轴上的一点点摩擦让它慢下来：在这个模型里，它会转约 80 s [S1, S29]。

车轮的数字是示意值，指的是架子上、没有人骑的一只轮子，不是自行车在路上的刹车时间 [S1]。

summary.en: Holds the wheel off the bench so it spins freely.
summary.zh: 把轮子架离台面，让它自由转动。

detail.en: A base with two uprights that hold the axle and carry the brake at the top, and a short handlebar for the brake lever [S1]. The wheel stays in one place, so only the brake changes from one run to the next.
detail.zh: 一个底座和两根立柱：立柱夹住轮轴，顶上装着刹车；旁边还有一小段车把，装着刹车把 [S1]。轮子不会跑开，每次只改变刹车。

summary.en: Squeezes rubber pads against the rim.
summary.zh: 把橡胶刹车块夹紧在轮圈上。

detail.en:
Two arms with a rubber pad on each, one on each side of the metal rim [S1]. Squeezed, the pads rub on the rim and friction slows the wheel: in this model a light squeeze stops it in about 1.8 s and a firm squeeze in about 0.6 s [S1, S29].

Wet rims make rim brakes work less well, so cyclists start braking earlier in the rain [S18, S19].
detail.zh:
两只夹臂，各装一块橡胶刹车块，分别在金属轮圈的两侧 [S1]。一捏刹车，刹车块就擦着轮圈，摩擦力让轮子慢下来：在这个模型里，轻捏约 1.8 s 停下，用力捏约 0.6 s 停下 [S1, S29]。

轮圈湿了，轮圈刹车的效果会变差，所以下雨天骑车要早一点刹车 [S18, S19]。

summary.en: Pulls the cable that closes the brake.
summary.zh: 拉动刹车线，让刹车夹紧。

detail.en: A lever on the short handlebar [S1]. Squeezing it pulls the inner cable, which draws the two brake arms together.
detail.zh: 装在那一小段车把上的手柄 [S1]。一捏它，就拉动刹车线里的钢丝，把两只刹车臂拉拢。

summary.en: Carries the pull from the lever to the brake.
summary.zh: 把刹车把的拉力传到刹车上。

detail.en: A steel inner wire in a plastic outer case [S1].
detail.zh: 塑料外套里穿着一根钢丝 [S1]。

summary.en: A smooth sole and a grooved rubber sole.
summary.zh: 一只光滑的鞋底和一只带花纹的橡胶鞋底。

detail.en:
A smooth leather sole and a rubber sole with deep grooves, both laid upside down [S1]. Grooves and soft rubber help a sole grip the floor.

The kind of floor matters too: shoes grip a dry wooden floor many times better than ice [S4].
detail.zh:
一只光滑的皮鞋底和一只带深纹的橡胶鞋底，都底朝上放着 [S1]。花纹和柔软的橡胶让鞋底抓得住地面。

地面也有关系：鞋子在干燥木地板上抓得比在冰上牢好几倍 [S4]。

summary.en: A force can change an object's shape.
summary.zh: 力能改变物体的形状。

detail.en: A soft foam block 10 × 7 × 4 cm [S1]. A brass weight pressing on it squashes it flatter; lift the weight off and the sponge springs back to its shape.
detail.zh: 一块 10 × 7 × 4 cm 的软海绵 [S1]。黄铜砝码压在上面，把它压扁；拿开砝码，海绵又弹回原来的形状。

summary.en: Presses down on the sponge.
summary.zh: 压在海绵上。

detail.en: A 200 g brass weight. Its weight, about 2.0 N, presses the sponge flatter [S1].
detail.zh: 一只 200 g 的黄铜砝码。它的重量约 2.0 N，把海绵压扁 [S1]。

summary.en: Pushes the car away without touching it.
summary.zh: 不用接触就把小车推开。

detail.en: A steel bar magnet with a north pole and a south pole [S1]. Laid behind the car with its north pole facing the north pole of the car's magnet, it pushes the car away across the gap: like poles repel [S1].
detail.zh: 一根钢制条形磁铁，有北极和南极 [S1]。把它放在小车后面，让它的北极对着车尾磁铁的北极，它就隔着空隙把小车推开：同极相斥 [S1]。

summary.en: A small magnet on the back of the car.
summary.zh: 装在小车尾部的一块小磁铁。

detail.en: A small magnet with its north pole facing backwards [S1]. A magnet can push or pull without touching: magnetic force acts across a gap.
detail.zh: 一块小磁铁，北极朝后 [S1]。磁铁不用接触就能推或拉：磁力能隔着空隙起作用。

summary.en: Gives the car a short push.
summary.zh: 给小车短短推一下。

detail.en: A wooden rod with a rubber tip [S1]. It shows where the push comes from: behind, in front or from the side. In this model a push from behind adds 0.3 metres per second to the car's speed [S1].
detail.zh: 一根带橡胶头的木杆 [S1]。它表示推力从哪里来：后面、前面或侧面。在这个模型里，从后面推一下，小车的速度增加每秒 0.3 米 [S1]。

summary.en: The bench that holds the experiments.
summary.zh: 摆放实验器材的台子。

detail.en: A wooden bench 1.80 × 0.70 m and 75 cm high, a generic design [S1]. The drop tower stands on the floor beside it.
detail.zh: 一张 1.80 × 0.70 m、高 75 cm 的木实验台，是通用设计 [S1]。落体架立在它旁边的地上。

value.en: 1.0 cm per 50 g · up to 300 g
value.zh: 每 50 g 伸长 1.0 cm · 300 g 以内

key.zh: 下落用时 · 左 · 右
